links.targetTitle: x402 turns HTTP 402 into an open, crypto-native payment standard for the web

title: x402 facilitators abstract payment verification and settlement behind /verify and /settle endpoints
content:
In x402, a **facilitator** is a trusted service provider that handles payment verification and settlement for sellers who don't want to run those functions themselves. Resource servers call the facilitator's `/verify` and `/settle` endpoints instead of watching chains directly.

**Why it matters:** this is the adoption lever — a web service can start charging per request without holding keys, running nodes, or understanding onchain settlement. It mirrors how payment processors abstracted card networks for web commerce.

**Trade-off:** it reintroduces a trusted party into an otherwise permissionless flow; servers can still verify independently if they prefer.

Source: x402 docs introduction (https://docs.x402.org/introduction).
description: A facilitator is a trusted service that verifies and settles payments on behalf of sellers, so resource servers need no onchain infrastructure of their own.
